description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the token count across different numbers of shots, categorized into reasoning and demonstration components. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled "Number of Shots," ordered sequentially from 0 to 4. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Token Count," featuring a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 7000 with tick marks at regular intervals of 1000. The chart utilizes stacked bars where the bottom segment, colored orange, represents "Reasoning," and the top segment, colored blue, represents "Demonstration," according to the legend positioned at the top. The bars are sorted in ascending numerical order based on the number of shots. The bar for 0 shots consists entirely of the orange Reasoning component and is the tallest on the chart, with its exact value annotated as 6393 above it. The shortest overall bar is for 1 shot, reaching an approximate total height of 4400. The subsequent bars for 2, 3, and 4 shots are also stacked with both Reasoning and Demonstration components, reaching approximate total heights of 4800, 5400, and 5000, respectively. A horizontal dashed line extends from the top of the 0-shot bar (at the value of 6393) across the entire width of the plot area. The stacked bars for 1 through 4 shots are visually emphasized with red downward-pointing arrows connecting this horizontal dashed line to the top of each respective bar. Each arrow is accompanied by red text indicating the exact negative difference in token count relative to the 6393 baseline: "-1952" for 1 shot, "-1613" for 2 shots, "-1040" for 3 shots, and "-1379" for 4 shots.
